plugin.description: Hide monster corpses with a reversible PoE 2 file patch. Supports Steam, Epic and the standalone launcher; apply and restore with the game closed.
help: Hide monster corpses using a reversible game-file patch. Supports Steam/Epic bundles and the standalone Content.ggpk. Changes take effect after restarting the game.
scope: Only corpse rendering is changed. Health values, health bars and gameplay settings are preserved. CPU/FPS gains depend on the scene.
native_help: The Oodle library is supplied by your own installation. Selecting Exile Forge extracts only oo2core.dll; its executable is never launched.
close_game: PoE is open. Close the game to apply or restore this patch. There is no instant in-game toggle.
backup: The original archive is kept in .GameHelperCadavres inside the game folder. Standalone installations need enough free space for a full copy of Content.ggpk. Restoration is refused if a game update or another tool has changed the patched archive.
